explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration for this result. The Mathlib files that mention SpectralSpace (Topology/Spectral/Basic.lean, Topology/Spectral/Hom.lean, RingTheory/Spectrum/Prime/Topology.lean) contain nothing about cofiltered limits. The closest hit is TopCat.nonempty_limitCone_of_compact_t2_cofiltered_system. It needs compact T2 spaces, and the proof here uses it only as one step, after passing to the constructible topology. That passage is the substance of the theorem and is not available in Mathlib in this form.
